meta.subject: We now flush left-over TLB results that remained resident in the DMA after an application completed

en.summary: Fixes stale DMA-side translation reuse by flushing cached last-translation state inside the DMA reader and writer when the accelerator TLB is flushed or an application boundary is crossed.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly describes left-over TLB results remaining resident in the DMA after an application completed.
The patch changes controller, scratchpad, and DMA hardware logic rather than tests or software.
The actual fix is to invalidate DMA-local translation-valid state on flush, which is a concrete address-translation correctness bug.
evidence: Controller.scala now drives spad.module.io.flush from the TLB exception flush signal.
Scratchpad.scala adds a flush input and forwards it to both DMA writer and DMA reader.
DMA.scala changes last_vpn_translated_valid in both StreamReaderCore and StreamWriter from RegInit(false.B) to a register reset by reset || io.flush.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: Many DMA engines keep a small local translation cache or “last translated page” filter to avoid repeated TLB lookups. That accelerator-local cache must be invalidated whenever software flushes the TLB or when a context boundary makes prior translations stale. If the central TLB is flushed but the DMA-local fast path is not, the accelerator can silently reuse an old physical mapping for a later request that matches the stale cached VPN.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: DMA translation-cache invalidation on TLB or context flush
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: After a TLB flush, context switch, or application teardown, a DMA request hits an accelerator-local cached translation entry that still appears valid.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Keep the DMA-local translation-valid bit alive across flush or context-reset events so stale translations remain reusable.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: omit flush invalidation for a local translation filter
portability_notes: Apply this to any accelerator that keeps a register-filter or tiny cache in front of the shared TLB/PTW.
The bug is especially relevant when accelerator DMA persists longer than a software process or protection domain.
If the design has separate read and write DMA paths, inject the stale-cache bug into one or both paths depending on the desired scope.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the DMA-side state that remembers the last translated virtual page and whether that cached translation is valid.
Remove the invalidation path that clears that valid bit on TLB flush, SFENCE-like operations, or accelerator context reset.
Keep the central TLB flush behavior intact so only the accelerator-local reuse path remains stale.
Preserve the fast-path hit check so future DMA requests can still bypass a fresh translation lookup when the stale VPN matches.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: flush propagation from Gemmini controller into DMA reader and writer last-translation registers
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds a flush signal from the controller to the scratchpad and DMA modules, then uses that signal to reset last_vpn_translated_valid in both StreamReaderCore and StreamWriter.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Restore last_vpn_translated_valid to a plain RegInit(false.B) in the DMA reader and writer and remove or disconnect the flush wiring added through Controller.scala and Scratchpad.scala.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: After a flush or application boundary, Gemmini DMA can reuse a stale physical translation and read or write the wrong memory page without rewalking the TLB.
evidence_for_injection: The commit message directly names stale TLB results remaining resident in the DMA.
The fix propagates flush all the way from the controller to both DMA datapaths.
The only semantic state reset by that new flush path is the DMA-side translation-valid register, matching the stale-cache bug description.
notes: A reproducer usually needs a TLB flush or context change between two DMA operations that use the same virtual page number with different mappings.
This is a translation-coherency bug inside the accelerator, not a software-driver issue.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 DMA 侧的陈旧地址翻译复用问题：当加速器 TLB 被 flush 或应用边界切换时，DMA reader/writer 内部缓存的“上一次翻译结果”也必须失效。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确指出，应用结束后 DMA 内仍残留旧的 TLB 结果。
补丁修改的是 controller、scratchpad 和 DMA 的硬件逻辑，而不是测试或软件。
真正的修复是在 flush 时使 DMA 本地的翻译有效位失效，这是明确的地址翻译正确性问题。
evidence: Controller.scala 现在把 TLB 异常接口上的 flush 信号驱动到 spad.module.io.flush。
Scratchpad.scala 新增 flush 输入，并把它同时转发给 DMA writer 和 DMA reader。
DMA.scala 把 StreamReaderCore 和 StreamWriter 中的 last_vpn_translated_valid 从普通 RegInit(false.B) 改为由 reset || io.flush 复位的寄存器。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 很多 DMA 引擎会保留一个很小的本地翻译缓存，或“最近一次翻译的页”过滤器，以减少重复 TLB 查询。只要软件执行了 TLB flush，或者上下文边界使旧映射失效，这种加速器本地缓存就必须同步失效。如果中心 TLB 已经 flush，但 DMA 本地快路径没有清空，加速器就可能在后续请求中静默复用旧的物理页映射。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: TLB 或上下文 flush 时的 DMA 翻译缓存失效
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 在 TLB flush、上下文切换或应用结束之后，一个 DMA 请求命中了仍被标记为有效的加速器本地翻译缓存项。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让 DMA 本地翻译有效位在 flush 或上下文重置之后继续保持，从而保留陈旧翻译。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 省略本地翻译过滤器上的 flush 失效逻辑
portability_notes: 适用于任何在共享 TLB/PTW 前面还保留寄存器过滤器或微型缓存的加速器。
当加速器 DMA 生命周期跨越软件进程或保护域时，这类缺陷尤其危险。
如果设计有独立的读/写 DMA 路径，可根据需要只在其中一路或同时在两路注入该缺陷。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到 DMA 侧用于记录最近一次虚页翻译以及其有效位的状态。
删除在 TLB flush、类似 SFENCE 的操作或加速器上下文复位时清零该有效位的路径。
保留中心 TLB 的 flush 行为不变，使陈旧状态只存在于加速器本地快路径。
保留本地命中判定逻辑，使后续 DMA 请求在 VPN 匹配时仍可绕过新的地址翻译。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Gemmini controller 到 DMA reader/writer 的 flush 传播，以及最后一次翻译寄存器的失效逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复从 controller 向 scratchpad 和 DMA 模块增加 flush 信号，并用它去复位 StreamReaderCore 与 StreamWriter 中的 last_vpn_translated_valid。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 把 DMA reader/writer 中的 last_vpn_translated_valid 恢复为普通 RegInit(false.B)，并移除或断开 Controller.scala 与 Scratchpad.scala 中新增的 flush 连线。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 在 flush 或应用边界之后，Gemmini DMA 可能复用陈旧的物理地址翻译，对错误的内存页执行读写，而且不会重新走 TLB。
evidence_for_injection: 提交信息直接指出 DMA 中残留了旧的 TLB 结果。
修复把 flush 一路从 controller 传到了两条 DMA 数据通路。
这条新 flush 路径唯一语义性重置的状态就是 DMA 侧的翻译有效寄存器，与“陈旧缓存”问题完全一致。
notes: 通常需要在两个 DMA 操作之间插入一次 TLB flush 或上下文变化，并让它们使用相同虚页号但映射到不同物理页，才能稳定复现。
这是加速器内部的翻译一致性缺陷，不是软件驱动问题。
